exceptions.reason: register is a flat closure factory (complexity 1) over 18 separately measured lithos_task_* handlers: 375 of its 1148 lines are the agent-facing MCP docstrings and 118 are tool signatures, leaving ~32 lines of adapter code per handler. Domain grouping plus the late-binding rule in lithos.tools keep registration together; a lifecycle/task-graph split would yield two registers still far above 75 and reduce, not remove, the finding. Headroom is for wiring edits or one new handler, not orchestration — that belongs in the service layer (task 3706b7f7).
